title: Proclamation of the abolition of the monarchy
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Proclamation of the abolition of the monarchy", at revision 1373171129, opens: "During the French Revolution, the National Convention proclaimed that it had abolished the French monarchy on 21 September 1792, giving rise to the French First Republic." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2264242, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "proclamation announcing abolition of French monarchy on 21 September 1792". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
